defects.statement: NginxBackend restored the previous vhost when its own test or reload failed, but exposed no inverse for a successful apply. A route that installed cleanly yet did not serve traffic could be detected as broken with no way to restore the working vhost.
defects.fix: NginxBackend and CompositeBackend gained ApplyWithCompensation; PublicRoutePlanner gained ApplyWithCompensation that fails loudly when a backend cannot produce an inverse.

defects.statement: DNS-plus-HTTPS route verification existed only inside CloudflareBackend.verifyHTTPS. Any second verification path would have duplicated the resolver and dial logic, which is the class of divergence that produced this outage.
defects.fix: Extracted a single shared resolver/dial-override transport builder into internal/httpclient, consumed by the route prober. It is built on hardenTransport so TLS verification cannot be disabled on any probe path.
